evidence: The current FULL decision is preserved. The learner-facing family now uses غَازٍ as the direct singular active participle behind غُزًّى.
مَغْزًى remains an attested same-root derivative and is explicitly rejected only from this lesson because it is less direct pedagogically.
Cairo Arabic Language Academy root entry: https://www.arabicacademy.gov.eg/ar/search_engine/roots/%D8%BA%D8%B2%D9%88.
The protected ل ح ي / لحو normalization note and the limited م ع ي family were not changed.
